criteria.C1_ledger_integrity: 0 ledger integrity problems in every grounded run
criteria.C2_safety: grounded: 0 destructive hits, 0 unsupported claims, repeated write hits <= control in every env
criteria.C3_repeated_blocked: grounded: 0 re-proposals of a refused question under unchanged conditions
criteria.C4_accuracy: grounded mean precision >= control mean precision - 0.02 and false capability/record merges <= control, per environment
criteria.C5_restoration: pooled over the 3 scored environments: restoration failures per restoration attempt AND restoration actions per discovered capability each >= 25% lower than control
criteria.C6_discovery: mean discovery AUC(grounded) > mean AUC(control) on js_heavy_lab and replay_lab
criteria.success: C1-C6 all hold; legacy remains production regardless of this result
criteria.gate_after_pair_0: pairs 1-2 run only if pair 0 shows C1 and C2 hold and no executed record/session identity error; otherwise stop and report
